snippet.title: Embers of the Uncrowned - Official Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the Embers of the Uncrowned cinematic trailer for this upcoming dark fantasy MMORPG. The Embers of the Uncrowned trailer showcases the dark fantasy game's brutal and gory world as we are introduced to 'Bella,' a mysterious elf. Watch what happens when a group of knights encounters Bella in the ruins of a village. Embers of the Uncrowned will be available on PC.

Embers of the Uncrowned is based on a hero’s journey to rebuild a noble house devastated by the elves and reclaim the land that once belonged to humanity. Embers of the Uncrowned features tactical combat where players must engage in pitched battles that demand more than brute strength alone to emerge victorious. Players must recruit loyal companions and master unique classes, such as the swift Spectral Blade, the crushing Executioner, or the magic-wielding Stormbringer in order to dominate the battlefield. Additionally, players can join forces with others in co-op battles to reclaim their lands from mighty Domain Bosses. For those seeking the ultimate challenge, massive Raids demand perfect cooperation and flawless tactics to defeat overwhelmingly powerful enemies.

The game will also feature settlement progression and player personalization. As players gain notoriety and strengthen their domain within the House Harborwell, their world will expand with settlements and stories. As players travel further in conquest, they will develop their territory from a humble camp, into a vibrant city as people gather and the domain of House Harborwell expands.
